skill.name: scan-job-boards
skill.description: Scan several job boards for new postings that match a search and list title, company, location and link. Use when someone wants a recurring job-board check across sites.
skill.summary: Delegate job-board searches to MyClawn and return matching postings with browser evidence.
skill.author: 20vision

content.user_title: Scan Job Boards for Matching Postings
content.value_statement: Checking several job boards repeatedly takes time and makes new postings easy to miss. This skill delegates a focused search to MyClawn and returns listing details with browser evidence.
actual_capabilities: Prepare searches using the requested job boards, keywords, region, and posting date window.
Delegate the search to the signed-in MyClawn Computer connector.
Request each matching posting's title, company, location, and link.
Support repeat checks through connector memory of previously shown postings.
Report the connector's answer, final-screen screenshot, and screen recording link.
Keep applications with the user and require wording review before third-party submissions.
limitations: Requires a signed-in MyClawn Computer connector; this skill does not include the connector implementation.
Repeat checks require another request; this file does not configure automatic scheduling.
Users must complete sign-in and solve captchas themselves.
Search completeness, retained history, screenshots, and recordings depend on the connector and accessible job boards.

use_cases.title: Find Relevant Openings
use_cases.description: Search several boards for recent roles matching a job seeker's keywords and preferred region.

use_cases.title: Review New Weekly Listings
use_cases.description: Repeat a focused search to request postings not shown during the previous check.
use_cases.target_user: Employed professionals exploring a career change

use_cases.title: Prepare a Client Shortlist
use_cases.description: Collect recent openings with company names, locations, and direct links for a client's review without submitting applications.

prompt_templates.title: Search One Board
prompt_templates.prompt: Check LinkedIn Jobs for software engineer postings in Vienna from the last seven days. List title, company, location, and link. Do not apply.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner search with one source and clear filters.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Several Boards
prompt_templates.prompt: Check karriere.at, LinkedIn Jobs, and StepStone for developer advocate postings in Austria from the last seven days. List title, company, location, and link. Do not submit forms.
prompt_templates.scenario: Search the same role across multiple sources.

prompt_templates.title: Repeat a Previous Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Repeat last week's developer advocate search across the same Austrian job boards. Show only postings not previously reported, with title, company, location, and link. Do not apply.
prompt_templates.scenario: Request a follow-up check using the connector's retained history.

prompt_templates.title: Define a Detailed Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Search [boards] for [keywords] in [region], posted within [time window]. Return title, company, location, and link; flag unclear matches. Do not submit applications or contact employers. Include the final screenshot and recording link.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced search with explicit scope, uncertainty handling, and reporting requirements.

output_examples.input: Search three boards for developer advocate roles in Austria from the last seven days.
output: Illustrative format only; these are not live search results.
Title: Developer Advocate | Company: Example Company | Location: Vienna, Austria | Link: direct posting link.
Evidence: final-screen screenshot and screen recording link supplied by the connector.

output_examples.input: Repeat my previous search and report only new postings.
output: Illustrative follow-up report, not a completed search.
New matching postings: none found in the accessible results.
Coverage: searched the requested boards using the previous filters.
Evidence: final screenshot and recording link, when available from the connector.

best_practices: Specify boards, keywords, region, date window, and required listing fields before starting.
Keep the search read-only and review wording before authorizing any third-party submission.
Review source links and browser evidence, and confirm history is available when requesting only new postings.
anti_patterns: Assuming the skill creates a recurring schedule without another request or separate scheduling setup.
Asking the connector to bypass captchas or create accounts on the user's behalf.
Treating a shortlist as complete or current without checking the linked postings.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: You need a signed-in MyClawn Computer connector. The skill references separate cloud-computer-task setup instructions, which are not included in this file.

faq.question: Which job boards can I request?
faq.answer: The example uses karriere.at, LinkedIn Jobs, and StepStone. You can specify other boards, subject to connector access and site restrictions.

faq.question: What information does the search return?
faq.answer: It requests title, company, location, and link for matching postings, plus the connector's final screenshot and recording link.

faq.question: Does it run automatically every week?
faq.answer: No automatic schedule is defined here. Request another check; the workflow relies on connector memory to recognize previously shown postings.

faq.question: Will it apply for jobs or contact employers?
faq.answer: Applications remain with you. The instructions prohibit sending anything carrying your name and require wording review before third-party submissions.

faq.question: How are sign-in and captchas handled?
faq.answer: You complete sign-in yourself. If a captcha appears, you solve it on the live screen.
